Murray developed a reputation for an innovative approach to design, applied not only to car concepts and details but also to race strategy.

4614.evidence: In 1986, Murray received an offer from Ron Dennis to join McLaren as Technical Director, taking over the role formerly held by John Barnard. Murray brought his Brabham experience to the McLaren design team, led by Chief Designer Steve Nichols. In the Constructors' Championship, McLaren's points score of 199 was at that time an all-time high. The MP4/5 and MP4/5B won the driver's and constructor's championships in both years.
